title: US PE firm Haveli Investments agrees to acquire a majority stake in business contract software company Sirion; a source says the deal values Sirion at about $1B (Reuters)
summary: Reuters: US PE firm Haveli Investments agrees to acquire a majority stake in business contract software company Sirion; a source says the deal values Sirion at about $1B — WHAT HAS BEEN AGREED? — Haveli will buy a controlling stake in Sirion, the companies said. They did not disclose the exact size or value of the stake.
